fields.statement: QA at db28257 with a binary built from the branch (go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza), in scratch git repos with RHIZA_* unset. Plan review round path: a run held at a wait step, 16 concurrent plain `rhiza run findings f.json --json` calls (3 findings each) all exited 0, responses named rounds 1..16 once each, the journal held 16 findings entries each numbered f1,f2,f3, and run status listed Round 1..16 with 3 findings each. Leaf and check paths: a real `rhiza run start` of a builder/verifier + checks workflow (stub rex/claude only launch the session; the findings calls are the real binary), the verifier and check alpha each firing 10 concurrent findings calls: all 20 exited 0, the leaf's findings were f1..f10 once each, and check alpha had rounds 1..10 (cycle 1) each with f1,f2. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/findings-concurrent -count=3 passed.
